title: Rubric import (the team's own rubric file)
description: Deliberately minimal: the team's rubric is imported as it is, whatever its field. Item categories and points differ by field (V5's conceptual / missing / technical groups are one example; a theory paper may have derivation errors). Which arrays hold items, and which item fields fill each display role, is declared in the paper configuration (categories[].source_array and field_roles); validation/rubric_checks.py checks the file against that declaration. Every field is preserved; contributors see only configured roles.
